name: Pibell Ganibell
source: Pibell is a very outgoing and nice girl who runs a pharmacy in the city. She is always full of energy and loves to spread it to others by suggesting activities. She never loses his smile, not even in the worst situations She also really likes handsome boys and having a couple, although unfortunately her relationships don't usually last long. She has hematophobia and cannot bear the sight of blood, causing her to pass out almost instantly.
